item.title: BerksGirlsBasketball.com
item.description: The 2025-26 Berks Girls Basketball All-Class Teams highlight the top freshmen, sophomores, juniors, and seniors across the Berks Girls League. Wilson led the county with a league and District 3 championship, while Exeter made its first county final in 49 years. See the full All-Class selections, including 11 unanimous picks and standout players from across Berks County.

item.title: Laila Jones, Elyssa Sellers, Laura Crocona Lead Team Red Past Team Blue in Berks County Girls Basketball Senior All-Star Game
item.description: Laila Jones scores 15 points, Elyssa Sellers adds 14, Laura Crocona 12 as Team Red defeats Team Blue 69-54 in the 2026 Berks All-Star Game.

item.title: Former Wyomissing Star Amaya Stewart Continues Shining at UAlbany
item.description: Former Wyomissing standout Amaya Stewart’s rise continued at the Division I level as the freshman forward captured America East Rookie of the Year and Sixth Player of the Year honors at UAlbany. After a dominant high school career, Stewart quickly became a fan favorite with her energy, toughness, and production, helping position the Great Danes for another championship push.

item.title: Peyton McDaniel’s Loyalty and Legacy Power Record Career at James Madison
item.description: Former Twin Valley standout Peyton McDaniel turned loyalty into legacy at James Madison, finishing her career with 2,325 points — ranking among the top scorers in NCAA women’s basketball history. Through injury, conference changes, and the transfer portal era, McDaniel stayed true to one program while building one of the greatest careers in JMU history.

item.title: All-State: Gov. Mifflin
item.description: Gov. Mifflin junior Bella Super earned Pennsylvania Sports Writers All-State honors for the second straight season, highlighting another standout year in which she led Berks County in scoring and pushed the Mustangs back into the PIAA playoffs while continuing her climb up the county’s all-time scoring list.

item.title: Former Berks Catholic Standout Madison Langdon Adjusts to College Game at Randolph-Macon
item.description: Former Berks Catholic standout Madison Langdon made an immediate impact during her freshman season at Randolph-Macon, appearing in all 29 games for a Yellow Jackets team that reached the NCAA Tournament. While her stats were modest, her versatility, defense, and growth stood out. Now, with a full year of college experience and postseason play behind her, Langdon is poised to take a significant step forward in year two.

item.title: Bella Super, Gov. Mifflin Put Scare into WPIAL Champ Canon-Mac in First State Playoff Appearance Since 2020
item.description: Bella Super poured in a game-high 25 points and Gov. Mifflin led entering the fourth quarter, but WPIAL champion Canon-McMillan rallied late to edge the Mustangs 48-46 Friday in the PIAA Class 6A first round in Canonsburg. Super tied the game with under 30 seconds left, but the Big Macs answered with late free throws to end Mifflin’s season.

item.title: Wilson vs. Cardinal O
item.description: Wilson meets Cardinal O’Hara in a highly anticipated PIAA 6A girls basketball second round matchup Tuesday at Coatesville. The Bulldogs bring a 20-game winning streak and balanced lineup into a rematch with the Philadelphia Catholic League powerhouse that handed them an early-season loss. Here’s a full preview of the clash between the Bulldogs and Lions.

item.title: Cardinal O
item.description: Wilson’s historic senior class saw its remarkable run end Tuesday night as Cardinal O’Hara claimed a 36-26 victory in a defensive battle in the PIAA Class 6A second round. Despite cold shooting on both sides, rebounding and free throws proved decisive as the Lions advanced. The loss closes a banner season for the Bulldogs, who captured Berks County and District 3 titles while cementing their legacy as one of the most accomplished classes in program history.
